items.title: JobGPS 2.10.24
items.body: Reads UKG job links on UKG’s Canadian site, reads Rippling job pages again after Rippling changed how they load (open jobs were being reported as closed), and Easy Apply jobs now also look for the company’s BambooHR job board.

items.title: JobGPS 2.10.23
items.body: Texas layoff notices now come straight from the Texas Workforce Commission’s own list (updated every few days). The layoff check now weighs a notice by its size, and lead-generation job ads (tiny agencies posting for an unnamed employer, or pages with far more followers than staff) are now flagged instead of getting the benefit of the doubt.

items.title: JobGPS 2.10.22
items.body: Layoff notices are now checked in 47 states plus Washington DC: every state that publishes a WARN list. Georgia, North Dakota, Massachusetts and Nevada were added, and Texas is read again after the state changed its data format. Arkansas, New Hampshire and Wyoming do not publish a list.

items.title: JobGPS 2.10.21
items.body: Reads Rippling job links through Rippling’s own job service, ADP links that leave out their career-center number, and ContactHR links (used by Remitly and others), which now open the company’s own job page. Torentify is treated as a job portal, not an employer.

items.title: JobGPS 2.10.20
items.body: When a company’s own hiring system lists a job as open, recent layoff news no longer pushes it down to Unconfirmed (it shows Likely real). Reads Rippling job links and more Workday links, and layoff notices now also cover Minnesota and Missouri.

items.title: JobGPS 2.10.19
items.body: Reads the apply link on LinkedIn’s new job page, asks “Did you hear back?” two days after a check so every label can be measured against what really happened, and checks layoff notices in 42 states plus Washington DC (up from 26).

items.title: JobGPS 2.10.17
items.body: A new look for the JobGPS page, the film section, and a full view of what is coming next with the Career Engine.

items.title: JobGPS 2.10.16
items.body: The panel now opens the JobGPS product page: what the free checker does, the Career Engine that is coming next, and every update.

items.title: JobGPS 2.10.15
items.body: Reads Dover and UKG job pages, follows a company’s own job-board link, and checks layoff notices in 29 states.
